    CASE RECORD

    Evidence & history

    Presenter notes & rules to confirm

    Start with Arbor Vale for intake, Glenhaven for Compliance, Larkspur for an independent capture check, or Harborline for a refusal at final QC. Select the named persona at each handoff. Everything is fictional and resets on reload. OBS and iCRM capture are simulated attestations.

    Demo assumptions: CRM performs uploads. The index reference and evidence source illustrate metadata pending the approved field catalog. An iCRM “No” stays with CRM until capture is confirmed. For failed final QC, Return sends a documentary correction to the team that submitted the record for QC; Reject closes the QC task as rejected without changing the earlier business decision or document validity. Confirm these rules before implementation. Stamps are recorded against the evidence in this prototype; the original PDF is preserved.
